briefs.claim_en: Under the Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026, the government is providing free laptops to all students.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including government statements and fact-checking organizations, refute the existence of a central government scheme providing free laptops to all students under the 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026'. NewsOnAir.gov.in, a government source, stated that claims about such a scheme are fake and no central government scheme exists. Similarly, PIB (Press Information Bureau) fact checks, as reported by abplive.com on August 11, 2026, confirm that neither the Government of India nor the Ministry of Education has announced any such scheme. Fact-checking sites like Alt News (June 4, 2019) and Vishvas News (February 28, 2023, February 18, 2025, August 30, 2023, May 8, 2024, September 29, 2020, December 23, 2024, December 8, 2022) consistently rate similar claims as false or scams, often identifying them as phishing attempts. While some state-level free laptop schemes exist (e.g., Uttar Pradesh's scheme, published September 6, 2026), there is no evidence of a nationwide Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme.

briefs.claim_en: The last date to apply for the Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026 is October 15.
briefs.brief_en: There is no evidence to support the claim that October 15 is the last date to apply for the 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026'. Government sources and fact-checking organizations have consistently stated that no such central government scheme exists (as detailed in the brief for claim c1). While some websites like taazarozgar.com (published September 20, 2026) and laptopyojana.in (published September 27, 2026) discuss application processes or required documents for various schemes, none of them mention a 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026' with an October 15 deadline. Similarly, articles discussing state-level free laptop schemes, such as buddy4study.com (published August 25, 2026), do not refer to this specific scheme or deadline. YouTube videos (published July 29, 2026, February 21, 2026) and Facebook posts (published October 4, 2026) also do not corroborate the existence of this scheme or its application deadline.
gaps_en: No official government announcement or credible news source confirms the existence of the 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026' or an application deadline of October 15.

briefs.claim_en: The official website for the Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026 is www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in.
briefs.brief_en: Government sources and fact-checking organizations refute the claim that www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in is the official website for a 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026'. NewsOnAir.gov.in, a government source, states that claims about the PM Laptop Scheme 2026 are fake and advises using myscheme.gov.in for authentic information. Similarly, PIB fact checks, as reported by abplive.com on August 11, 2026, indicate that viral messages about free laptop schemes, including their associated links and formats, are fake. AFP Fact Check (published March 13, 2025) also reported on imposter government websites targeting users with free laptop scams. While some websites discuss online application processes for various schemes (e.g., taazarozgar.com, published September 20, 2026), none identify www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in as an official portal. For instance, the UP Free Laptop Yojana uses digishakti.up.gov.in for registration (schemesinindia.in, published September 6, 2026).
gaps_en: No official government source confirms www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in as the official website for any Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme.
